# implement-spec ledger — P15.4 watch + evidence

- **spec:** docs/tickets/P15.4__watch-evidence.md (§39.5, §39.5a, §39.6; §29.7, §17.5)
- **base commit:** 43d5b1669a0e6227927183ad13a8a5f8c4608c62 (P15.3)
- **branch:** devin/p15-4-watch-evidence
- **scope:** web/ only (SIG-ENG-010). Additive; reuse P15.1 epistemic components + P15.2 next_decision_date.

## Requirements (from spec)
1. SIG-UI-026 — renewal watch: per contract expiry, renewal window, notice deadline, approving body, next meeting, replacement procurement.
2. SIG-UI-027 — subscriptions by jurisdiction, iCal + RSS, keyed on next_decision_date.
3. SIG-UI-027a — evidence recommender ranks by §39.5a inputs only (D, currency vs volatility, open contradictions, open tasks, artifact-type-vs-decision, capture_status). J-3 executable.
4. SIG-UI-027b — neutrality guard: MUST NOT rank by persuasiveness/sentiment/vote-effect.
5. SIG-UI-027c — exportable citation list with permalinks + as-of dates.
6. SIG-UI-028 — evidence viewer: document w/ supporting span highlighted at locator; claim; extraction method+version; review status; conflicting claims; capture date+digest; acquisition method; full claim history.
7. SIG-UI-029 — capture diffing field-by-field (§29.7).
8. SIG-UI-030 — sealed captures metadata-only + explanation (§17.5).

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 surfaces exist + function (watch, recommender, viewer). deterministic
- AC2 iCal + RSS by jurisdiction, keyed on next_decision_date. deterministic
- AC3 recommender ranks only by directness/currency/dispute; test asserts persuasiveness/sentiment/vote absent. deterministic
- AC4 recommender output exportable as citation list w/ permalinks + as-of dates. deterministic
- AC5 viewer highlights span at locator; diffs two captures field-by-field; sealed = metadata-only + explanation. agentic
- AC6 contested values marked at every appearance (conflicting-claims view, API, export). deterministic
- AC7 phase-gate §51.3: CI green; new reqs have tests; ADR for deviations; traceability + risk-register updated.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- No plate/trip/per-person storage. Append-only/provenance. Additive/back-compat (don't fork next_decision_date wire name).
- Every claim has evidence; every inference labelled; contradictions stay visible.

## Pipeline field-name fidelity (mirror, don't reinvent)
- directness D1..D6 (D6 EXCLUDE); currency C1..C4 labels current/aging/stale/historical (reconcile.weight, inference.freshness).
- capture: storage_tier public|restricted|sealed; capture_status (failing: link_rotted/access_restricted/paywalled); capture_method; content_digest; retrieved_at; source_uri; extraction_method + layer/version; locator.
- next_decision_date: reuse web/src/lib/dossier.ts nextDecisionDate/resolveTermination (SIG-UI-014b).
